description: Desktop permissions for the Econ Worksheet editor: the system print dialog (PDF export; on macOS window.print() is routed to the webview print command), native save/open dialogs, document storage under the app data directory, restart-after-update, and opening exported files in their default app. Files picked in a save/open dialog are added to the fs scope by the dialog plugin at runtime, so fs grants stay on $APPDATA plus creating the one default export folder ($DOCUMENT/Econ Worksheets). Revealing a file (opener:default's reveal_item_in_dir) is unscoped in opener 2.5; open-path covers the folders a teacher normally saves to (app data, Documents, Downloads, Desktop) - anything else falls back to reveal. $HOME/** is deliberately not granted.
